title: On a twisted Singer conjecture
summary: According to the Singer conjecture, the $L^2$-Betti numbers of a closed aspherical manifold are expected to vanish outside the middle dimension. In this paper, we study a natural analog of the Singer conjecture concerning the vanishing of twisted $L^2$-Betti numbers outside the lower middle dimension. These invariants can be thought of as $L^2$-Betti numbers of an infinite cyclic cover, depending on a first cohomology class.
